description: Change a page's settings: the feedback due date (reviewers see it and get a reminder the day before), pausing or resuming new comments, and the page's name. Pass only what should change. The due date has to fall before the page's link expires (Free links last 14 days). It doesn't change the page itself: use update_page to publish new content.

comments_paused.description: Optional. true pauses new comments and replies from reviewers (everyone can still read them); false lets them comment again.

due_date.description: Optional. The feedback due date as YYYY-MM-DD, within the next year, or "none" to clear it.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

timezone.description: Optional. The user's time zone, like Asia/Kolkata or America/New_York, so the due date ends at midnight for them. Defaults to UTC.

title.description: Optional. A new name for the page, as shown in My projects and emails. The review link stays the same.

name: update_page_settings
title: Change a page's settings
